title: CaseTemplateFile
description: Documentation-only. Shape of MovieTracker.Evals/eval-movie-templates.json. Owner-review invariant: exactly eight templates, one per TemplateCheck value, with the exact question strings spec FR-005 names. Exactly one of 'template' or 'turns' is present per entry. The harness does NOT validate the file against this schema at run time; the loader enforces only unique ids.

id.description: Stable id, unique within the file. Used as the prefix of every generated case id ('<id>-<slot>').

template.description: Single-turn question with the applicable placeholders ('{title}', '{actor}', '{overview}', '{genre}', '{decade}'). Mutually exclusive with 'turns'.

turns.description: Ordered turn texts for multi-turn templates (currently only 'followUpDirector'). Mutually exclusive with 'template'.

check.description: The check kind that grades this template's case. Each check kind has its own IEvalCheck implementation (spec FR-022).
